import sys

def main():
    values = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        values.extend(map(int, line.strip().split()))

    n = len(values)
    if n == 0:
        print("count 0")
        return

    mean = sum(values) / n
    mean_rounded = round(mean, 2)
    if mean_rounded == int(mean_rounded):
        mean_str = f"{mean_rounded:.2f}"
    else:
        mean_str = f"{mean_rounded:.2f}"

    s = sorted(values)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        median = s[n // 2]
    else:
        median = (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2

    counts = {}
    for v in values:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    mode = min(key for key, value in counts.items() if value == max(counts.values()))

    range_val = max(values) - min(values)

    print("count", n)
    print("mean", mean_str)
    print("median", f"{median:.1f}" if median % 1 else str(median))
    print("mode", mode)
    print("range", range_val)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
